authEndpoint.description: Stargate's auth endpoint, used to exchange the username/password for a session token, e.g. localhost:8081.

authKind.description: Authentication mode: Astra application token (0) or username/password credentials (1).

grpcEndpoint.description: gRPC data endpoint of a self-hosted Cassandra/DSE cluster fronted by Stargate (https://stargate.io), e.g. localhost:8090.

secure.description: Use a secure (TLS) connection to Stargate.

user.description: Cassandra database username, for a self-hosted cluster accessed via Stargate credentials.

secureValues.description: Astra DB application token, format: AstraCS:xxxxx, generated from the Astra console under Organization Settings > Token Management.
Cassandra database password, for a self-hosted cluster accessed via Stargate credentials.
